questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code records what changed on a ticket in the audit log? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
If the audit sink's append() rejects after repo.save() has succeeded in apply(), what does the caller of changeStatus observe?
choices: The call resolves normally with the updated ticket and the failure is only logged
The call rejects, even though the ticket change has already been persisted
The ticket save is rolled back automatically and the call rejects
The call resolves, and the audit entry is retried in the background

questions.prompt: Which information does an AuditEntry carry that lets an investigator tie it back to a specific inbound API call?
choices: The entry id produced by randomUUID()
The requestId taken from the AuditContext

questions.prompt: An agent calls escalate() on a ticket that is already 'urgent'. What is recorded?
choices: An entry with action ticket.priority_changed and identical before/after
Nothing: the method returns the ticket without saving or auditing
An entry with action ticket.priority_changed and priority 'urgent' in after
An error is thrown because order.indexOf returns the last index
